2693.title: Electron 41 input backlog drain grows super-linearly
2693.rootCauseOneLine: The Electron 41 runtime pinned by bb drains a queued input backlog with super-linear cost.
2693.proposedFix: Update Electron, regenerate the lockfile, rebuild native modules, and complete desktop packaging and updater validation.
2693.caveats: The controlled runtime mechanism reproduced twice. The intermittent natural macOS lock and exact Chromium implementation were not verified.
